title: Reference Plan
description: Per-shot, per-provider reference selection (production/scenes/<SC_ID>/references/): exactly which approved assets condition generation, why, at what priority and weight, and what breaks if each is omitted. Written before any prompt is compiled.

provider.description: Provider ID the plan is budgeted for (its capabilities.referenceImages limit applies).

required.description: References that must be included; if the provider's budget cannot fit them all, escalate instead of silently dropping.

optional.description: References to include if budget remains after all required entries, in priority order.

exclude.description: Assets that must NOT be used for this shot (e.g. a wrong-state wardrobe version).

asset_id.description: Versioned asset ID from a bible's reference registry (e.g. CHAR_MARA_FACE_MASTER_V03).

entity.description: Base entity the asset represents (e.g. CHAR_MARA).

purpose.description: What the reference conditions in the output.

priority.description: Drop order when the provider's reference budget is exceeded (low drops first; critical never drops).

crop.description: Crop to apply before submission (e.g. face_only, upper_body, full_frame).

weight.description: Conditioning strength for providers that support weighted references.

reason.description: Why this asset is in the plan for this specific shot.

omission_risk.description: What visibly breaks if this reference is dropped (identity drift, wrong geometry, ...).
